seo.description: Use the power converter to switch between kW, HP and PS. Select the source unit and compare the converted value with the engine manufacturer’s original data.

fields.heading: Power Converter
fields.lead: Enter a value, the remaining units are converted immediately.

blocks.html:
More about power converter

The power converter helps compare figures from different documents in one unit. First, check the original label because HP and PS are different units. Then enter the value and select the matching source unit. Keep the original figure beside the converted result when preparing a comparison table.
